evidence.excerpt: We introduce GACC-Bench, a benchmark for Goal-Adaptive Context Compression that evaluates how reliably LLMs adapt information retention to specified high-level goals.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Context compression in long-running applications of large language models (LLMs) must preserve goal-relevant information, often before specific downstream questions are known.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Compared with goal-agnostic compression, target-goal conditioning consistently improves accuracy, whereas mismatched-goal conditioning reduces it.
